Pick the file for your system, or let the [website](https://bassman8k.github.io/cordite/) choose for you.

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Cordite-Setup-win-x64.exe` (installer) or `Cordite-Portable-win-x64.exe` (no install) |
| macOS | `Cordite-mac-arm64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) or `Cordite-mac-x64.dmg` (Intel) |
| Linux | `Cordite-linux-x64.AppImage` or `Cordite-linux-x64.deb` |
| Android | `Cordite-android.apk` |
| iPhone and iPad | [Play in Safari](https://bassman8k.github.io/cordite/play/), then Share, Add to Home Screen. `Cordite-ios-unsigned.ipa` is for sideloading. |
| Browser | [Play now](https://bassman8k.github.io/cordite/play/) or `Cordite-web.zip` |

The builds are not code-signed yet. The [README](https://github.com/Bassman8K/cordite#download) explains the one-time prompt on each system, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every file.

Testing? Start with the [testing guide](https://github.com/Bassman8K/cordite/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md).
